fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck driveway from the SW dock yard crosses a continuous east-west perimeter fence at a single defined pinch-point gate (43.1749,-73.7174); fence rails visible running across the grass strips on both sides of the drive in gate-cross-z20.png.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small light-colored booth-sized structure sits beside the truck lane at the gate crossing (booth-z21.png / gate-cross-z20.png). Footprint is small and partly shadowed so this is medium-confidence visually, but corroborated by Target's published on-site Target Security Specialist (TSS) staffing for this RDC.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because guardShack is true (staffed booth present).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dozens of angled dock bays with trailers backed in run the full length of the building's SW/west face across two long banks (wide-z16, nw-corner-z18); easily 50+ doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large trailer-storage drop yards: one south of the building and a dense SE trailer-storage lot (se-yard-z19, main-entrance-z19) holding several hundred trailers without tractors; well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and ample yard width at the entrance allow an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main RDC plus a separate maintenance/fleet building near the SE yard; campus is a single operation so multipleFacilities=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Wilton/Saratoga, surrounded by woods, farmland and the I-87 Northway corridor; rural setting.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~95 ac estimated from the perimeter polygon spanning the building, west dock yards, south + SE drop yards and employee parking.
fieldNotes.streetView: No Street View coverage at the gate or perimeter (private property; nearest panos are 2007/2022 rural-road shots that do not reach the entrance), so streetViewMeta hasCoverage=false for both zones.
